name: tourist
description: Two independent Next.js apps sharing one MongoDB (the public website and the CMS), plus a small WebSocket service that pushes new enquiries to the CMS.

scripts.build: npm --prefix public-site run build && npm --prefix cms run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix public-site run lint && npm --prefix cms run lint
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix public-site install && npm --prefix cms install
